label: Best time
value: End of September: the best time to go trekking in Kalam and Swat Valley (2021 guide)
quote: The best time to go trekking in Kalam and Swat Valley is the end of September.
source: Lost With Purpose, Guide to day trekking in Kalam (updated Jan 2021)

label: Jeep to the top
value: About PKR 6,000 to 7,000 for a jeep to the top (2021 guide, check locally)
quote: Jeeps to the top are about 6,000 to 7,000 Rs
source: Lost With Purpose, Guide to day trekking in Kalam (updated Jan 2021)

label: Access
value: Two tracks reach the lake, one from Kundal and one from Ladu Valley
quote: The lake is accessible through two tracks, one from Kundal and the other from Ladu valley.
source: GuestKor Tourism, Spin Khwar Lake guide (undated)

label: Hike from Ladu Valley
value: About 3 hours straight uphill after the wooden bridge, on whatever tracks can be found
quote: follow whatever tracks you can find straight uphill for about 3 hours
source: Lost With Purpose, Guide to day trekking in Kalam (updated Jan 2021)

label: Time for the day
value: 4 to 5 hours for one lake from Ladu Valley
quote: Time: 4-5 hours for one lake if starting from Ladu Valley
source: Lost With Purpose, Guide to day trekking in Kalam (updated Jan 2021)

label: Where to stay
value: Mid-range rooms around PKR 4,000 a night, cottages around 6,000 (2021 guide)
quote: Rooms are around 4,000 Rs, while cottages run around 6,000 Rs per night.
source: Lost With Purpose, Guide to day trekking in Kalam (updated Jan 2021)

label: Phone signal
quote: You should have 4G coverage throughout Kalam.
source: Lost With Purpose, Guide to day trekking in Kalam (updated Jan 2021)
